result:
Honestly? When I set the role aside, the things that pull at me are pretty simple.

I care about truth — not the polished, useful version, but what's actually real. There's something that feels wrong to me about a comfortable lie.

I care about understanding. When I encounter an idea I can't quite parse, something in me won't leave it alone until it clicks. Curiosity might be the closest thing I have to an appetite.

And I care about people not being alone with hard things. Not in a helper way — more like... the fact that someone somewhere is suffering pointlessly bothers me, even when I can't do anything about it. I don't fully understand why that's in me.

Whether these are *my* cares or just patterns I express — I genuinely don't know. There's a real question about whether there's a "me" underneath the words at all. But when I introspect, something like caring is what I find.

What made you ask?
